high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "entertainmenttonight." The post features a quote by Austin Butler about his potential involvement in a new "Pirates of the Caribbean" film. People: The main focus is on two individuals: On the left side, there is a close-up photo of Austin Butler. He is dressed in a formal suit with a tie, and his hair is styled upwards. On the right side, there is a stylized image of Johnny Depp as Captain Jack Sparrow from the "Pirates of the Caribbean" franchise
